_about: The title screen every visitor sees on every arrival from outside the site, on the home page and /obavia.html: key art behind Jason's name, Press start (with the score) or Start muted, Who's playing (three seats), then on the home page a build (the visitor picks the role they're hiring for, the problem on their lot, or a class, and builds Jason for it from verified facts), an optional player name that signs the card, the card, then the library. intro.js reads this; tools/site/assemble_home.py inlines it into both pages as #onboarding-data. Every line must be true and in llms.txt. No em dashes.

title.line: AI Implementation, Workflow Automation, CRM Systems
title.note: The score is part of the game. Press M or the Score button to turn it off any time.

question.title: Who's playing?
question.fine_pointer: Or press 1, 2 or 3. You can switch later.

roles.p: Interviewer or recruiter. The record first, then the systems.
Dealer or partner. What answers my phones and runs my lot.

name.title: Enter your name
name.fine: So I know who stopped by. Only I see it.
name.fine_build: Your name goes on the card. It also tells me who stopped by.

card.edit: Change it any time from Player 2 in the top bar.

interviewer.title: What are you hiring for?
interviewer.sub: Pick the role and build me for it. You keep the card and a one-page resume written for that job.

partner.title: What's slowing your lot down?
partner.sub: Pick one. You'll see what runs at Triple J for it, and keep the card.

lurker.title: Pick a class
lurker.sub: Build me however you like and keep the card. Every line on it is a verified fact.

build.paste_p: I'll match its words to my record
build.paste_fine: Read on your device. It never leaves this page.
build.none: Nothing in it matched my record. Pick the closest role instead.
build.fine_pointer: Arrows and Enter, or press a number. You can change it later.
